object_state_precedence: Any object-level or row-level hard failure makes every hour in that symbol-month U and emits zero normalized rows; only a wholly valid object may emit A and M; N requires no frozen ZIP object.

normalized_output.container: one deterministic gzip CSV per symbol
normalized_output.source_decimal_serialization: preserve exact validated source CSV text
normalized_output.csv_quoting: minimal RFC 4180-style quoting using comma delimiter

numeric_hard_gates.ohlc: finite and greater than zero; low <= open and close <= high
numeric_hard_gates.volumes: base, quote, and taker-buy volumes finite and nonnegative
numeric_hard_gates.taker_buy_subset: taker-buy base <= base volume and taker-buy quote <= quote volume with exact Decimal comparison
numeric_hard_gates.ignore: preserve source text and report observed values; do not require zero

resume_policy: A crash may resume only under an identical raw-root run contract. Existing final objects are conditionally refetched with If-Match and byte-compared; partial files never imply success. Once terminal experiment artifacts are published, any later retry that would change them requires a successor experiment/data version instead of overwriting this experiment.
duplicate_policy: fail object validation; never choose a row
